remarks: This is one level living at its best! Completely updated 2 bedroom, 1.5 bath on the first floor with closets galore! Modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances opens up to dining area with sliding doors to your own private deck facing the courtyard! Sparkling newer bathrooms, both bedrooms equally bright and spacious! To top it off, laundry in unit and to add even more storage you get a 10x20 room in basement! Complex complete with a pool and playground. 1 reserved parking space and plenty of visitors parking. This desirable location allows you to walk to Glenbrook train station (.4miles) and minutes from downtown where you have access to the hottest restaurants, shopping and Stamford train station! This is not to be missed!
